summary: One bordered shell around a text input or textarea with addons (icons, text, buttons) before, after, above or below it.

validation.note: error draws the whole shell in the error color and sets aria-invalid="true" on the slotted control (a native input or textarea directly; a sb-input or sb-textarea on its host, which passes it to its inner control). Also give the error message outside the shell (sb-field-error).

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.notes: Bordered flex container in the shadow root. role=group only when the host has an aria-label.

default.notes: One control (sb-input with hide-label, a native input, a native textarea, or sb-textarea with hide-label) and any number of sb-input-group-addon children, as direct children.

focus-within.trigger: focus inside the control (not the addon buttons)
focus-within.note: Tracked with focusin and focusout on the control, set as data-focused on the shell; :has() does not reach into other shadow trees.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The control keeps its own name: sb-input needs label (use hide-label), a native control needs aria-label or an external label. The shell exposes role=group named by the host aria-label only when one is set. Icon-only sb-input-group-button children need aria-label.

formAssociation.note: The slotted control is the form field; the shell adds none.

accessibility.targetSize: Control and buttons keep the 24px minimum of their own components; the shell is 36px high.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: One 3px solid ring on the whole shell while the control is focused; the inner control's own ring is switched off. Addon buttons keep their own focus ring.

keyboard.Tab: control, then each addon button in DOM order
keyboard.Enter: in a text input, submits through the control; on an addon button, activates it

aria: group: role="group" with the forwarded aria-label, only when set
validation="error": aria-invalid="true" on the slotted control (native, or the host of sb-input / sb-textarea)
addon icons are decorative; mark them aria-hidden
clicking an addon outside a button moves focus to the control
sb-input-group-button passes its slotted text to the inner button as the name and updates it when the text changes, including edits to a text node in place; an aria-label on the host wins

elements.summary: A strip of content (icon, text or buttons) placed before, after, above or below the control inside the shell.

align.note: Where the addon sits. A block-* addon turns the shell into a column.

anatomy.name: addon
anatomy.notes: Flex row of icons, text and buttons; clicking outside a button focuses the control.

elements.notes: Must be a direct child of sb-input-group.

elements.summary: Muted, non-interactive text or icon inside an addon, such as a currency symbol or a unit.
A compact sb-button for use inside an addon. An icon-only one needs aria-label.

size.note: Passed to the inner sb-button; icon sizes are square.

type.note: Submit and reset are done by the group button itself (it is form-associated for that), because the inner sb-button sits in a shadow root outside the page's form. name and value are not supported.

anatomy.name: button
anatomy.notes: sb-button in the shadow root; host aria-label is forwarded to it.

click.note: From the inner button; cancelled while disabled.

useCases.when: An input with a leading icon, a currency symbol or a unit
An input with an inline action such as copy or clear
useCases.use: sb-input-group-addon align=inline-end with an icon-only sb-input-group-button and aria-label

useCases.when: A textarea with a toolbar underneath
useCases.use: a textarea and a block-end sb-input-group-addon

antiPatterns.why: The button has no accessible name

antiPatterns.pattern: sb-input with its label visible inside a group
antiPatterns.why: The label would sit inside the bordered shell
antiPatterns.alternative: Use hide-label and put the visible label outside the group

antiPatterns.pattern: More than one control in a group
antiPatterns.why: The shell shows one focus ring and one invalid state

coverage: shell height and token border; slotted sb-input and native input draw none
addon order by align; block addons stack
focus ring on the shell for the control only, no second ring
validation error: shell color and aria-invalid on the slotted control
addon click focuses the control, button click does not
icon-only button named by aria-label, click composed
slotted sb-textarea: shell ring, no second ring, addon click focuses it
button name follows text edited in place

drift.realization: slotted native inputs keep the browser placeholder color; ::slotted cannot be followed by ::placeholder
the visual reference uses ring/50; the invalid focus ring is solid destructive, not the reference 20% tint, so focus differs from invalid at rest (WCAG 2.4.7, 1.4.11)

drift.contract: sb-input-group-button is form-associated and submits or resets itself
drift.realization: the visual reference renders a plain button in the page tree; the inner sb-button here sits in a shadow root outside the form. name and value are not supported
the visual reference dims the whole group when its control is disabled; here the control and buttons dim themselves (Q3)

coverage: InputGroup: 4 variant(s), State (Rest, Focus) x Validation (None, Error); read back ok

drift.contract: Padding of a block-start or block-end addon (a header or footer over a textarea).
drift.realization: The set draws an inline-start addon with an input; block addons are not drawn yet.

drift.contract: A disabled slotted native input or textarea is dimmed.
drift.realization: The InputGroup set has no disabled variant: the shell has no disabled state of its own (Q3), so the dimmed control is not drawn.

openQuestions.question: How is the slotted sb-input made to look borderless inside the shell?
openQuestions.recommendation: Set its own tokens (--sb-input-border, -bg, -shadow, -radius, -focus-ring-*) from ::slotted(sb-input). Input already reads them.
openQuestions.answer: Slotted rules override the Input tokens.

openQuestions.question: How does the shell show focus and invalid when :has() cannot cross shadow trees?
openQuestions.recommendation: focusin and focusout on the control set data-focused on the shell; validation="error" sets data-invalid and aria-invalid.
openQuestions.answer: data-focused from focusin/focusout; explicit validation prop.

openQuestions.question: A disabled shell?
openQuestions.recommendation: Not now: the control and buttons dim themselves; a shell-level disabled adds little.

openQuestions.question: Placeholder color of a slotted native input?
openQuestions.recommendation: ::slotted() cannot be followed by ::placeholder, so the browser default stays; use sb-input where the placeholder token matters. Logged as drift.
openQuestions.answer: Browser default placeholder for native controls.
